content: LangGraph state channels using reducers (e.g. Annotated[list, add] / operator.add or add_messages) accumulate rather than overwrite on every node write - in a bounded correction loop (Solver->CodeGen->Test->Review, repeated), any state field defined this way (e.g. review history, generated code attempts, messages) grows every iteration and is fully included in the checkpoint at each super-step, so checkpoint storage size scales with iteration count x number of accumulating fields. LangGraph enforces recursion_limit (default 25) counted in graph super-steps, not in application-level 'correction iterations' - a correction loop spanning 4 nodes per iteration hits GraphRecursionError after ~6 iterations even if the intended max_iterations was configured higher/differently at the app level, so the app-level bounded-loop counter and the graph-level recursion_limit must be reconciled deliberately, not left at framework defaults.
